introduction.title: Introduction
introduction.content: At Cube Book, we take your privacy very seriously. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our application. Please read this privacy policy carefully. If you do not agree with the terms of this privacy policy, please do not access the application.

informationWeCollect.title: Information We Collect
informationWeCollect.content: We collect minimal data necessary to provide and improve our services: Personal Data: We do not collect personally identifiable information such as name, email address, or phone number unless you voluntarily provide it. Usage Data: We collect anonymous usage statistics automatically to improve app performance and user experience. Voice Recordings: Voice inputs used for speech recognition are processed in real-time and are not stored on our servers.

howWeUse.title: How We Use Your Information
howWeUse.content: We use the collected information to: Provide and maintain our service, Improve and personalize your experience, Analyze usage patterns to enhance features, Communicate with you about updates and new features.

dataSharing.title: Data Sharing and Disclosure
dataSharing.content: We do not sell, trade, or transfer your information to third parties except: With your explicit consent, To comply with legal obligations, To protect our rights, property, or safety, or that of others.

dataSecurity.title: Data Security
dataSecurity.content: We implement appropriate security measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, alteration, or destruction. All voice processing is encrypted in transit and we follow industry best practices for data protection.

yourRights.title: Your Rights
yourRights.content: You have the right to: Access any personal data we have about you, Request correction of inaccurate data, Request deletion of your data, Withdraw consent at any time.

cookies.title: Cookies and Tracking
cookies.content: We use essential cookies to ensure the application works properly. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies. You can disable cookies through your browser settings, although this may affect the application's functionality.

children.title: Children's Privacy
children.content: Our application is suitable for users of all ages. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you are a parent or guardian and believe your child has provided personal data, contact us.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.content: We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the 'Last updated' date.

contact.title: Contact
contact.content: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, contact us at: Email: privacy@cubebook.app
